parameters.content:
## $0 by design — same copy/paste pattern as Phase 1-2, 5-8

No Anthropic API key here either. Pauses on a form showing you the
Analytics Agent's exact system prompt (Agent #11 in 03-AGENT-PROMPTS.md)
— copy it into your own Claude.ai / Claude Code chat, then paste the JSON
back.

## Channel-level, not video-level

Unlike Phase 1/5-8, this form asks for a Channel Name, not a Topic Title
— Agent #11's input is a channel's recent `analytics_snapshots` +
`channel_strategy_log`, not a single video.

## Honest limitation: this cannot run yet — confirmed empty, 2026-09-02

`analytics_snapshots` had 0 rows for every channel when this was built.
That's not a bug, it's because nothing has actually published to YouTube:
Phase 8 (Publishing/SEO) only queues `publish_jobs` rows, it doesn't call
the YouTube Data API (no OAuth credential exists — see its sticky note),
and there is no separate analytics-ingestion job wired to pull real
YouTube Analytics data even if a video had been published. This workflow
will throw a clear error (in 'Check Analytics Exist') rather than run
with zero real data or invent numbers — it needs at least one real
`analytics_snapshots` row for a video belonging to the named channel.

Built, wired, and activated per the same discipline as every other
phase, but genuinely UNTESTED end-to-end for the same reason Phase 6/7
were initially untested: no real data exists yet to run it against, and
fabricating a snapshot row to force a green test would violate the
no-invented-data rule this whole build follows.

## What it does once real data exists

1. Pulls all `analytics_snapshots` for videos belonging to the named
   channel (via a two-step video-id lookup, since the table only has
   `video_id`/`short_id`, not `channel_id` directly).
2. Pulls the last 4 `channel_strategy_log` entries for context/continuity.
3. On the pasted verdict: inserts a new `channel_strategy_log` row for
   this week (`week_of` = this Monday, UTC) with `insights` (per-video
   review) and `next_actions` (exactly 3, per the agent's own
   contract).
4. If the paste includes `updated_composite_score_weights`, PATCHes
   `channels.composite_score_weights` — otherwise leaves it untouched.

## Before running this

1. Requires at least one real `analytics_snapshots` row for a video
   belonging to the named channel.
2. Reuses the **Supabase account** credential — wire it into every HTTP
   node that hits `/rest/v1/...`.
3. Activate, open the Form Trigger's Production URL, enter the exact
   Channel Name.
